metadata.description: A fictional, scripted human telecaller call used to test coach mode. No real call, merchant or recording.

turns.speaker: human_agent
turns.text: Namaste, main Sunita bol rahi hoon, payment products ke baare mein call kiya hai. Kya do minute baat kar sakte hain?

turns.speaker: human_agent
turns.text: Aapki dukaan par UPI payments badh rahe hain, kya aapne Soundbox ke baare mein socha hai?

turns.speaker: merchant
turns.text: Mere paas pehle se dusra QR laga hua hai, wahi chal raha hai.

turns.speaker: merchant
turns.text: Aur iska kiraya kitna hai? Baad mein koi extra charge toh nahi katega?

turns.speaker: human_agent
turns.text: Main aapko details bhej deti hoon.

turns.speaker: merchant
turns.text: Haan, theek hai, aap official link bhej dijiye.
